en.review.recorded-future.recorded.future.i: Recorded Future is the world's largest provider of real-time threat intelligence, using AI and machine learning to analyze over 1 billion indicators of compromise (IOCs) daily from open sources, dark web, technical sources, and proprietary feeds. The platform transforms raw threat data into actionable intelligence that security teams can immediately operationalize.
en.review.recorded-future.what.sets.recorde: What sets Recorded Future apart is its patented Risk Score technology that automatically prioritizes threats based on real-time evidence—not just static reputation data. The platform continuously monitors thousands of sources including criminal forums, paste sites, code repositories, social media, and closed threat actor communities to provide early warning of emerging threats targeting your organization.
en.review.recorded-future.with.native.integ: With native integrations into SIEMs, firewalls, EDR platforms, and security orchestration tools, Recorded Future enriches your existing security infrastructure with contextual intelligence that accelerates detection, investigation, and response.
en.review.recorded-future.patented.ai-drive: Patented AI-driven risk scores prioritize threats based on real-time evidence and context.
en.review.recorded-future.continuous.monito: Continuous monitoring of criminal forums, marketplaces, and closed communities.
en.review.recorded-future.comprehensive.pro: Comprehensive profiles of APT groups, cybercrime gangs, and nation-state actors.
en.review.recorded-future.real-time.trackin: Real-time tracking of CVEs with exploitation likelihood and proof-of-concepts.
en.review.recorded-future.native.connectors: Native connectors for Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel, and 100+ security tools.
en.review.recorded-future.customizable.aler: Customizable alerting on indicators, threat actors, and topics relevant to your organization.

en.review.recorded-future.phishing.and.bran: Phishing and brand monitoring. Separate module

Brand Protection: Monitoring phishing, fraud, and brand abuse
Small businesses with limited security budgets
en.review.recorded-future.organizations.wit: Organizations without dedicated threat intel analysts
en.review.recorded-future.companies.seeking: Companies seeking basic IOC feeds only
en.review.recorded-future.the.platform.anal: The platform analyzes indicators across thousands of sources and assigns risk scores (0-99) based on observed malicious activity, threat actor associations, exploit availability, and targeting evidence. Scores update in real-time as new evidence emerges, enabling prioritization of genuine threats.
en.review.recorded-future.the.platform.inge: The platform ingests data from 1B+ indicators daily including: open web, dark web forums, paste sites, code repositories, social media, technical feeds, closed threat actor channels, OSINT, government advisories, and proprietary research.
en.review.recorded-future.yes.native.integr: Yes. Native integrations exist for 100+ security tools including Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel, Palo Alto, Fortinet, ServiceNow, and more. RESTful API enables custom integrations. Threat feeds available in STIX, JSON, CSV formats.
en.review.recorded-future.absolutely.the.vu: Absolutely. The Vulnerability Intelligence module tracks CVEs, correlates them with exploit code availability, active exploitation in the wild, and threat actor interest—enabling teams to prioritize patches based on real-world risk, not just CVSS scores.
en.review.recorded-future.while.the.platfor: While the platform automates much analysis, maximum value requires analysts who can interpret intelligence, tune alerts, and operationalize findings. Recorded Future offers training programs and professional services to build analyst capabilities.
en.review.recorded-future.recorded.future.i: Recorded Future is the gold standard for enterprise threat intelligence. Its vast data collection, AI-driven risk scoring, and extensive integrations make it indispensable for organizations facing sophisticated threats. While premium-priced, the platform delivers unmatched early warning capabilities and actionable intelligence that justifies investment for security-mature organizations.

pt.review.recorded-future.recorded.future.i: Recorded Future é o maior fornecedor mundial de inteligência de ameaças em tempo real, usando IA e aprendizado de máquina para analisar mais de 1 bilhão de indicadores de comprometimento (IOCs) diariamente de fontes abertas, dark web, fontes técnicas e feeds proprietários. A plataforma transforma dados brutos de ameaças em inteligência acionável que as equipes de segurança podem operacionalizar imediatamente.
pt.review.recorded-future.what.sets.recorde: O que diferencia o Recorded Future é sua tecnologia patenteada de Pontuação de Risco que prioriza automaticamente ameaças com base em evidências em tempo real, não apenas dados estáticos de reputação. A plataforma monitora continuamente milhares de fontes, incluindo fóruns criminosos, sites de pastebin, repositórios de código, mídia social e comunidades fechadas de atores de ameaças para fornecer aviso antecipado de ameaças emergentes direcionadas à sua organização.
pt.review.recorded-future.with.native.integ: Com integrações nativas em SIEMs, firewalls, plataformas EDR e ferramentas de orquestração de segurança, o Recorded Future enriquece sua infraestrutura de segurança existente com inteligência contextual que acelera a detecção, investigação e resposta.

pt.review.recorded-future.native.connectors: Conectores nativos para Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel e mais de 100 ferramentas de segurança.
pt.review.recorded-future.customizable.aler: Alertas personalizáveis sobre indicadores, atores de ameaças e tópicos relevantes para sua organização.

As pontuações são atualizadas em tempo real conforme novas evidências emergem, permitindo a priorização de ameaças genuínas.
pt.review.recorded-future.the.platform.inge: A plataforma ingere dados de 1B+ indicadores diários incluindo: web aberta, fóruns da dark web, sites de pastebin, repositórios de código, mídia social, feeds técnicos, canais fechados de atores de ameaças, OSINT, comunicados governamentais e pesquisa proprietária.

pt.review.recorded-future.absolutely.the.vu: Absolutamente. O módulo de Inteligência de Vulnerabilidades rastreia CVEs, correlaciona-os com disponibilidade de código de exploração, exploração ativa em campo e interesse de atores de ameaças, permitindo que as equipes priorizem patches com base no risco do mundo real, não apenas em pontuações CVSS.
pt.review.recorded-future.while.the.platfor: Embora a plataforma automatize muita análise, o valor máximo requer analistas que possam interpretar inteligência, ajustar alertas e operacionalizar descobertas. Recorded Future oferece programas de treinamento e serviços profissionais para construir capacidades de analistas.
pt.review.recorded-future.recorded.future.i: Recorded Future é o padrão-ouro para inteligência de ameaças empresarial. Sua coleta vasta de dados, pontuação de risco impulsionada por IA e integrações extensas a tornam indispensável para organizações que enfrentam ameaças sofisticadas. Embora com preço premium, a plataforma oferece capacidades de aviso antecipado incomparáveis e inteligência acionável que justificam o investimento para organizações maduras em segurança.

zh.review.recorded-future.recorded.future.i: Recorded Future是全球最大的实时威胁情报提供商，使用AI和机器学习每天分析来自开源、暗网、技术来源和专有源的超过10亿个危害指标(IOC)。该平台将原始威胁数据转化为可操作的情报，安全团队可以立即实施。
zh.review.recorded-future.what.sets.recorde: Recorded Future的与众不同之处在于其获得专利的风险评分技术，可根据实时证据自动优先处理威胁，而不仅仅是静态信誉数据。该平台持续监控数千个来源，包括犯罪论坛、粘贴网站、代码存储库、社交媒体和封闭的威胁行为者社区，为针对您组织的新兴威胁提供早期预警。
zh.review.recorded-future.with.native.integ: 通过与SIEM、防火墙、EDR平台和安全编排工具的原生集成，Recorded Future用上下文情报丰富您现有的安全基础设施，加快检测、调查和响应速度。

zh.review.recorded-future.the.platform.anal: 该平台分析来自数千个来源的指标，并根据观察到的恶意活动、威胁行为体关联、漏洞可用性和目标证据分配风险评分(0-99)。随着新证据的出现，评分会实时更新，以实现对真正威胁的优先级排序。
zh.review.recorded-future.the.platform.inge: 该平台每天摄取来自10亿多个指标的数据，包括：公开网络、暗网论坛、粘贴网站、代码存储库、社交媒体、技术源、封闭威胁行为者渠道、OSINT、政府咨询和专有研究。
zh.review.recorded-future.yes.native.integr: 是的。存在针对100多种安全工具的原生集成，包括Splunk、QRadar、Sentinel、Palo Alto、Fortinet、ServiceNow等。RESTful API支持自定义集成。威胁源可用STIX、JSON、CSV格式。
zh.review.recorded-future.absolutely.the.vu: 绝对可以。漏洞情报模块跟踪CVE，将其与漏洞代码可用性、野外活跃利用和威胁行为体兴趣相关联，使团队能够根据实际风险而不仅仅是CVSS评分优先处理补丁。
zh.review.recorded-future.while.the.platfor: 虽然该平台可以自动化许多分析，但最大价值需要能够解释情报、调整警报和实施发现的分析师。Recorded Future提供培训计划和专业服务来建立分析师能力。
zh.review.recorded-future.recorded.future.i: Recorded Future是企业威胁情报的金牌标准。其广泛的数据收集、AI驱动的风险评分和广泛的集成使其对面临复杂威胁的组织不可或缺。虽然价格昂贵，但该平台提供无与伦比的早期预警能力和可操作的情报，对安全成熟的组织的投资是合理的。

Recorded Futureのインターフェースを探索：
ja.review.recorded-future.the.platform.anal: プラットフォームは数千のソースからインジケータを分析し、観察された悪意のあるアクティビティ、脅威行為体の関連付け、悪用の可用性、および対象化の証拠に基づいてリスクスコア(0-99)を割り当てます。新しい証拠が出現するにつれて、スコアはリアルタイムで更新され、本物の脅威を優先順位付けできます。
ja.review.recorded-future.the.platform.inge: プラットフォームは、公開Web、ダークウェブフォーラム、パステサイト、コードリポジトリ、ソーシャルメディア、技術フィード、閉じた脅威行為体チャネル、OSINT、政府勧告、専有研究を含む、10億以上のインジケータから毎日データを取得します。
ja.review.recorded-future.yes.native.integr: はい。Splunk、QRadar、Sentinel、Palo Alto、Fortinet、ServiceNowなど、100以上のセキュリティツール用のネイティブ統合が存在します。RESTful APIはカスタム統合を有効にします。脅威フィードはSTIX、JSON、CSV形式で利用可能です。
ja.review.recorded-future.absolutely.the.vu: 絶対に。脆弱性インテリジェンスモジュールはCVEを追跡し、悪用コードの可用性、野での活発な悪用、脅威行為体の関心と関連付けて、チームがCVSSスコアだけでなく、実際のリスクに基づいてパッチを優先順位付けできるようにします。
ja.review.recorded-future.while.the.platfor: プラットフォームは多くの分析を自動化していますが、最大値にはインテリジェンスを解釈し、アラートを調整し、検出結果を運用化できるアナリストが必要です。Recorded Futureはアナリスト機能を構築するためのトレーニングプログラムとプロフェッショナルサービスを提供しています。
ja.review.recorded-future.recorded.future.i: Recorded Futureはエンタープライズ脅威インテリジェンスの金の標準です。その膨大なデータ収集、AI駆動リスクスコアリング、広範な統合により、高度な脅威に直面する組織にとって不可欠です。プレミアム価格設定ですが、プラットフォームは比類のない早期警告機能と実行可能なインテリジェンスを提供し、セキュリティが成熟した組織の投資を正当化します。
